sources.title: GitHub - ClawLabsAI/free-ai-models: Daily-updated list of free AI ...
sources.snippet: The team behind ZeroLimitAI, a hosted AI app and API whose router ranks free models with this same function. We keep the list accurate because our own product depends on it; the list itself stays MIT, provider-neutral and useful without us — a model belongs here whether or not we route to it, and several of the highest-ranked ones we do not.
